lines: Ten build agents are running, each in its own machine at the strongest setting: the glass with its bubble; the liquid and the simulation; the flakes and the veil; the slab, the backdrop and the lens; the base with its icicles; the village; the tree; the frost and the arrival; the light engine; the shake as a hand model.

Each one works against the approved image through the reference camera, pushes pictures of its part every 25 minutes, and sends a first report at about 90 minutes. Their pictures appear here from the next status on.

Before the start two shared contracts were written so that no two builders edit one file: the unseen room as one module that the glass, the brass and the light engine all reflect, and a map of the snow that has come to rest, which the roof and the boughs can read to thicken.
The published app still shows the Phase 2 stand-in globe until the first real parts are merged, about 11:30 UTC.
phase 3: 1.57 h used of its 11.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 8.18 h used of 36.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: The approved winter image with the regions each builder works against. Ten builders started at 10:00 UTC, one owner per file, each building its part of winter for real: no stand-in may remain in what a still shows.
The opening camera, four candidates on stand-ins. Bottom right is the chosen frame: chimney, window, door, floor, lamppost and the foot of the tree, no edge of the glass (by engine_engineer_2)
The hero camera after decision 35, winter at rest, draft: 7.8 percent above the glass, 4.2 percent under the foot of the base (it was 10.3 and 1.7) (by root)

The app's screen after the new rule, at rest, at the top of the lift and at the widest stroke: 1920 by 1080 above, 390 by 844 and 1024 by 1366 below. The foot of the base now stands 7 percent of the height above the controls on the two wide screens (by film_app_engineer_2)
